Name: SageFelix - RRRR Magnus Portraits
Author: SageFelix
Description:
[center]NOW WITH A PIXEL-ART VERSION!![/center]

Meant to use with the mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped

[/url]I will make different versions for the pixel portraits sooner or later (2, 7, 12 expressions)﻿

TOGGLEABLE OPTIONS:
[list]
[*]Hat: hides or shows Wizard's pointy hat. Activated by default.
[*]Seasonal: enables seasonal outfits, if it is turned off, it will show the Fall outfit by default. Activated by default.
[/list]
IF THE PORTRAITS DON'T SHOW:

If you have [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits[/url] mod or any mod that changes Wizard's portraits/sprites, please delete the Wizard/Magnus files from those mods

If you have HD Portraits mod installed please delete it and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=files]Portraiture[/url], you don't need to move files, just [b]press [P][/b] and portraits should show.
